useWhen: An operator hands over a timeline JSON and asks for its ffmpeg render plan with narration cues
avoidWhen: Encoding video, generating footage or voices with AI, or treating the plan as a finished mp4

inputs.aspect: portrait or landscape when the operator names one

outputs.plan: ordered segments with frame/voice/text and the display-only ffmpeg recipe

authority.binding: caller authorization; the mcp server must be enabled in the profile by its owner

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-24: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with raw JSON-RPC on synthetic fixtures plus a kbb stdio integration test; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. The steps call MCP tools by their itonami-agent names (mcp__<server>__<tool>) and assume the server key in mcp_servers matches the entry id.
